description:
**Who Are We?**
 The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota\-based company that has been in business since 1914\. We pride ourselves on providing world\-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100\+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 To grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Build and evolve database models across relational and NoSQL databases to support core platform features such as scheduling, invoicing, and crew management.
* Integrate and manage cloud services.
* Create and maintain responsive, accessible UI components aligned to the design system.
* Integrate with external platforms to extend capabilities across areas like CRM, accounting, search, and AI.
* Develop message\-driven processing pipelines and serverless automation for asynchronous workflows, billing cycles, and system maintenance.
* Own form development for complex multi\-step workflows such as job creation, invoicing, and customer onboarding.
* Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, maintaining high code coverage standards with CI integration.


**What Do You Need?**
 To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information systems, and 5\-8 years of professional full stack development experience.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and build tools, such as Webpack, Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or equivalent.


**Frontend Skills**
* Expert proficiency in a modern JavaScript framework, such as React (v16\+), with TypeScript.
* Strong state management experience with libraries such as Redux, including middleware patterns and memoized selectors.
* Experience with cloud\-based authentication and storage integration, such as AWS Amplify, Cognito, or similar services.
* Proficiency with responsive design and component styling approaches, such as Bootstrap, CSS\-in\-JS (Styled Components), with accessibility awareness (WCAG 2\.1 AA).
* Hands\-on E2E testing experience with frameworks such as Cypress, including intercepts, custom commands, and CI integration.


**Backend Skills**
* Expert proficiency in Node.js and Express.js, or similar server\-side frameworks, for building production\-grade REST APIs.
* Strong experience with NoSQL databases, such as MongoDB/Mongoose, and relational databases, such as MySQL/Sequelize, including query optimization and indexing.
* Hands\-on cloud services experience, such as AWS (S3, SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch) or equivalent platforms.
* Solid understanding of asynchronous programming patterns, such as Promises and async/await. Proficiency in writing testable code with testing frameworks such as Mocha/Chai/Sinon or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of REST API design principles, authentication mechanisms (such as JWT, OAuth 2\.0\), and security best practices.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with scheduling/drag\-and\-drop UI libraries, such as FullCalendar React or react\-beautiful\-dnd.
* Server\-state management libraries, such as React Query (TanStack Query).
* Data visualization experience with libraries such as Chart.js or D3\.js.
* React Native or cross\-platform mobile development experience.
* Client\-side document generation experience, such as jsPDF or html2canvas.
* CRM or accounting platform API integration experience, such as Salesforce or QuickBooks.
* Static analysis tooling experience, such as SonarQube or equivalent.
* AI\-integrated development tools, such as Copilot CLI or Claude Code.


**What Can We Give You?**
**Benefits**
 At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our employees know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive salary, an affordable and top tier medical insurance plan and many other great benefits – The Toro company offers employees a variety of perks, including:
   

  

* Dress for your day – We know you’re more productive when you’re comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment.
* Location – Conveniently located in Baner, Pune. We are centrally located for most commuters!
* Food – Take advantage of our café, which serves both breakfast and lunch. You can grab a snack and coffee at any time during your day.
* Wellness – The Toro Company offers complimentary use of our onsite fitness facility to employees. In addition to physical well\-being, TTC offers a variety of mental health and financial health resources to all employees.
* Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide employees 20 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community.
* Flexible Work Arrangements – This team is currently implementing a hybrid work schedule. The opportunity to collaborate in the office and work from home part\-time has promoted team building and flexibility.
* Competitive Salary – The pay range takes into account skills, experience, education, and location. Cash compensation is one piece of our competitive total rewards package. Eligibility and award amounts are determined by company policy and performance metrics.


 At The Toro Company, we are committed to fostering a secure and trustworthy recruitment process for our applicants. Recruitment fraud is a potential threat to job seekers, so please be aware that throughout our recruitment process, you’ll never be required to pay any fees or disclose personal financial details when applying to TTC opportunities.
   

  

 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy and related needs and conditions, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or other non\-merit based factors. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Senior Developer
description:
Join us as a Senior Developer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Senior Developer ,you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* AWS hands on with S3, EC2, Lambda, RDS, Glue, Athena, data pipelines, step function and knowledge of Analytical services.
* Experience of distributed computing architecture, Core Hadoop components (HDFS, Spark, Yarn, HIVE, Impala).
* Expertise in SQL, advanced SQL skills.
* Expertise in shell scripting and programming (Scala/Python).
* Knowledge of ETL technologies preferably Ab Initio.
* Experience of Technical Design for ETL/Hadoop/AWS components.
* Knowledge of Data Warehousing.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To build and maintain the systems that collect, store, process, and analyse data, such as data pipelines, data warehouses and data lakes to ensure that all data is accurate, accessible, and secure.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Build and maintenance of data architectures pipelines that enable the transfer and processing of durable, complete and consistent data.
* Design and implementation of data warehoused and data lakes that manage the appropriate data volumes and velocity and adhere to the required security measures.
* Development of processing and analysis algorithms fit for the intended data complexity and volumes.
* Collaboration with data scientist to build and deploy machine learning models.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Engineer to work on Qualys’ next\-generation data platform and middleware. Working alongside a very talented team of engineers and architects, you will be responsible for prototyping, designing, developing and supporting a highly scalable SaaS based cloud security data platform. This is a great opportunity to be an integral part of a team building Qualys’ next generation microservices based technology platform processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day, leverage open source technologies, and work on challenging and business\-impacting projects.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a data platform engineer you will be responsible for the team running data stored with millions of transactions per second, scaling 100s of terrabytes of data. Responsible for driving the data source and providing data platform as a service to all applications built in Qualys.
   

  

 You will be reviewing the application architecture and identify the data scale needs. Investigate the cutting edge technologies and do POC and then responsible for rolling out in production. Be the face and developer advocate of the stack you own and contribute back to open source community if any enhancement needed to fit in Qualys ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be instrumenting both day 1 and day 2 operations on these data technologies keeping the 100s of thousands if not millions of operations per second. Migrate, burst into cloud and scale the stack with zero or least amount of downtime.
   

  

 You will be responsible for delivering resilient client SDKs to the applications to communicate with the data source you are responsible for.
   

  

 You will be constantly in the hunt for better solutions out there to resolve the current scaling, availability and cost effective alternative solutions.
   

  

 Co\-develop with a strong sense of ownership Qualys’ big\-data platform that scales to meet/exceed the demands of processing over a 100 million transactions and terabytes of data per day. Architecture, performance, scalability, high availability and security will be your primary goals for delivering a first\-rate experience to our customers.
   

  

 Work closely with engineering teams, product management and operations to provide platform and infrastructure features and components to support Qualys’ business objectives.
   

  

 Produce high quality software following good architecture and design principles that you and your team will find easy to work with in the future.
   

  

**A day in the life…**
* Apply advanced concepts, theories and principles to create multi\-disciplinary innovations and solutions for the most complex or risky data source related situations
* Contribute to development of new data platform principles and concepts
* Collaborate with and suggest best practices to application teams in Qualys
* Provide thought leadership across multiple teams to ensure that systems and services are designed, and operating to achieve optimal levels of performance, reliability and sustainability interacting with data platform in Qualys
* Ensure security coding practices and security system fundamentals across multiple teams
* Demonstrate ability to identify important areas to instrument across multiple teams


**Who You Are...**
* A trendsetter. You thrive in an intellectually challenging environment with leading edge technologies.
* A teacher. You’re able to mentor your peers and help our team grow.
* A learner. You have an insatiable thirst for knowledge and greater understanding.
* A pragmatist. Your goal is to create useful products, not build technology for technology’s sake.
* An empath. You understand what the customer needs and use that perspective to create the best user experience.


**How We Work...**
* With others. We have remote pairing tools where engineers often work together, as well as virtual collaboration tools for building out architecture solutions.
* With transparency. We encourage open dialog and discourse. We don’t encourage silos.
* With agility. We don’t believe in following a process for process’s sake. We ship frequently and focus on delivering incremental value.
* With open minds. We are committed to building a diverse team of people with unique perspectives. This encourages a healthy and inclusive environment that builds a more sustainable, successful company.
* With pride. We value our people most of all. We invest in ourselves by applying our own strengths and interests to company needs.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience .
* 6\+ years hands\-on experience with developing SaaS based software products and solutions for service\-oriented deployments in public (AWS, GCP, Azure, OCI, etc.) or private clouds.
* Prior experience with RDBMS systems and NoSQL databases.
* Proven expertise in data\-driven critical thinking problem\-solving
* Ability to debug systems of software and people
* Demonstrated ability to write high\-quality, production\-ready code (readable, well\-tested, with well\-designed APIs)
* Demonstrated passion for innovation with an ability to work within agile software development methodologies
* Experience with infrastructure orchestration and automation tools (Terraform)
* Hands\-on experience using CI/CD pipelines
* Data platform design / build utilizing Cassandra, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Ceph, Flink, Spark or similar technologies
* Strong analytical and debugging skills.
* Java programming skills including object\-oriented design, prototyping, development, testing, profiling, etc.
* Knowledge of JVM concepts like garbage collection, heap, stack, profiling, class loading, etc.
* Strong in data structures and algorithms.
* Ability to clearly articulate and communicate technical concepts within and across teams.
* Knowledge of the below is a plus
* Built a data platform from the ground up.
* Experience with applying data encryption and data security standards.
* Experience with container and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes etc.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Graphite, Grafana and Prometheus.
* Experience with HashiCorp technologies such as Consul, Vault, Terraform and Vagrant.
* Experience with configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet or Ansible.
* In\-depth experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines.
* Exposure to Maven, Ant or Gradle for builds.

 Topdeta is building the data infrastructure that powers the next generation of frontier AI.  We're hiring freelance software developers who are masters in at least one of the following languages:
 **TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, or C\+\+** 
 .
 



 You will design and build challenging engineering tasks inside real open\-source codebases. Each assignment involves deep\-reading an unfamiliar production repository, scoping a substantial multi\-file feature, implementing it according to the repository's standards, and writing tests to verify the implementation.
 



 Full project context, tooling, and detailed guides will be shared after onboarding.
 



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 




  




* **3\+ years** 
 of professional software development experience
* Strong proficiency in at least one of:

* Proven experience working inside
 **large production codebases** 
 in your primary language
* **Experience working in large production codebases is strictly required**
* Strong knowledge of automated testing in your preferred language
* Public GitHub profile demonstrating real coding activity
* Strong written English
* Clear technical writing skills —
 **technical communication is a significant part of this role**
* Basic familiarity with Docker



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Comfortable navigating large, unfamiliar codebases and following existing conventions
* Solid automated\-testing experience using tools such as
 **Vitest, Jest, Pytest, Go Test** 
 , or equivalent
* Strong Git skills, including patches, diffs, branching, and clean commits
* Able to scope, manage, and complete multi\-day engineering assignments independently
* Strong attention to code quality, maintainability, and testing



  





**IMMEDIATE\-HIRE SIGNALS (GOOD TO HAVE)** 




  




* Merged pull requests into open\-source projects you don't own
* Open\-source maintainer or contributor experience
* Experience leading or mentoring small engineering teams



  





 We are looking for
 **core coders** 
 who can not only deliver high\-quality engineering work independently but can also
 **build and manage their own teams as we scale** 
 .
 



  





**TRIAL PERIOD \& ONBOARDING** 




  





 The initial period will be treated as a
 **trial period** 
 .
 



 Once you complete and have
 **one task approved** 
 , we will officially onboard you as a
 **contractor/freelancer with Topdeta** 
 .
 



  





 The
 **entire initial trial period — from the beginning of the week until you receive your first approved task — will be considered the trial period** 
 . The trial period may therefore last for the whole week or until the first task is successfully approved, whichever occurs first.
 



  





 After your first approved task, you will proceed with official contractor/freelancer onboarding and continue receiving assignments based on project requirements and performance.
 



  





**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING** 




  




* Understand and navigate unfamiliar, large\-scale open\-source repositories
* Analyze existing architecture, code, tests, and conventions
* Scope and implement substantial multi\-file engineering tasks
* Write comprehensive automated tests
* Produce clean, maintainable, production\-quality code
* Document your technical decisions clearly
* Work independently and deliver within agreed timelines
* Potentially contribute to building and managing engineering teams as Topdeta scales

 In this role you will design, build, and maintain the software that manages and controls the XiP platform. This engine is responsible for 1\.5 billion risk \& suitability calculations at Citi every day. The calculation engine at the core of XiP is both highly performant and rapidly changing to support new scenarios, technologies, and infrastructure.
   

  

 As an engineer working on XiP, you will work on a platform which daily; coordinates hundreds of thousands of pods, consumes tens of thousands of compute cores, utilizes hundreds of TB of memory, and distributes hundreds of millions of calculations.
   

  

 You will work closely with software engineers, DevOps, and our customers to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable operations of the platform.

 Apply your experience and skills to develop the future versions of the calculation engine. This means making it faster, utilize resources better, and scale to even greater sizes. This means solving hard problems like transferring small amounts of data to a huge number of machines.

description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself for more than two decades. The invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. GPU\-powered deep learning helped ignite the era of modern AI, establishing GPUs as the foundation of intelligent applications across productivity, gaming, and creative workflows, and reinforcing NVIDIA’s position as a leading AI computing company.
   

  

 More recently, there is a growing focus on running AI models locally, closer to where data is generated. This approach reduces latency, enables real\-time processing, and addresses privacy concerns by minimizing the need to send data to centralized servers. As technology continues to evolve, client\-side AI will play an increasingly important role in shaping the digital landscape. The LocalAI team is seeking a Senior Systems Software Engineer to develop efficient on\-device AI software for RTX and DGX\-class systems. The role focuses on delivering high\-performance local inference with low latency, optimized memory utilization, robust infrastructure, and practical deployment on resource\-constrained platforms.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Partner with NVIDIA’s software, research, architecture, and product teams to align technical requirements and strategic priorities, fostering the AI ecosystem on RTX and DGX PCs.
* Build and optimize the local AI inference stack for RTX, RTX Pro, and DGX GPUs, with a focus on performance, stability, and scalability across diverse hardware architectures.
* Design and develop modern inference runtimes and execution stacks using frameworks such as llama.cpp, vLLM, PyTorch, WinML, DXCGC, and TensorRT\-RTX, supporting LLM, vision\-language, TTS, ASR, and diffusion\-based AI workloads.
* Perform end\-to\-end optimization of AI models, data pipelines, and inference runtimes to maximize performance on current and next\-generation GPU architectures. Apply model optimization techniques, including quantization, pruning, sparsity, and distillation, to enable efficient deployment of large models on local and edge devices.
* Conduct system\-level debugging, performance tuning, and performance\-accuracy trade\-off analysis; develop infrastructure for performance and accuracy sweeps; analyse results to identify gaps and drive fixes; and establish engineering guidelines to accelerate bring\-up and ensure production readiness of new models and inference backends.


**What We Need To See**
* 5\+ Years of experience with Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent C\+\+ programming and debugging skills, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and machine learning.
* Proven experience developing and optimizing AI inference pipelines and applications using ML/DL frameworks such as Llama.cpp, vLLM, PyTorch, Windows ML, DXCGC, and TensorRT.
* Deep understanding of inference backends and runtime internals, including scheduling, memory management, KV\-cache behaviour, graph execution, quantization, and hardware\-aware optimization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across engineering teams and management.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Understanding of modern machine learning, deep neural network, and generative AI techniques, with relevant contributions to major open\-source projects.
* Consistent track record of delivering end\-to\-end products in multinational companies with geographically distributed teams.
* Proficiency in low\-level system and GPU programming, CUDA, and the development of high\-performance systems.
* Contributions to open\-source inference runtimes, model tooling, or performance infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience building applications using frameworks and APIs such as llama.cpp, PyTorch, TensorRT, Vulkan, DirectX, and vLLM.

 Minimal travel as required for position responsibilities – less than 10%, depending on candidate location.

 This candidate will work from a home office when not at client site

title: Principal/Senior/Software Engineer (AI-Powered Advertising Agents - AgenticOS)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is looking for engineers with expertise in Generative AI and AI agent development. You will be responsible for building and optimizing advanced AI agents that leverage the latest technologies in Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and large language models (LLMs). You will work on developing state\-of\-the\-art solutions that enhance Generative AI capabilities and enable our platform to handle complex information retrieval, contextual generation, and adaptive interactions.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI\-driven features. Drive end\-to\-end ownership—from feasibility analysis and design specifications to execution and release—while ensuring quick iterations based on customer feedback in a fast\-paced Agile environment.
* Spearhead technical design meetings and produce detailed design documents that outline scalable, secure, and robust AI architectures.
* Ensure that the solutions are aligned with long\-term product strategy and technical roadmaps.
* Implement and optimize LLMs for specific use cases, including fine\-tuning models, deploying pre\-trained models, and evaluating their performance.
* Develop AI agents powered by RAG systems, integrating external knowledge sources to improve the accuracy and relevance of generated content.
* Design, implement, and optimize vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate) for efficient and scalable vector search, and work on various vector indexing algorithms.
* Create sophisticated prompts and fine\-tune them to improve the performance of LLMs in generating precise and contextually relevant responses.
* Utilize evaluation frameworks and metrics (e.g., Evals) to assess and improve the performance of generative models and AI systems.
* Work with data scientists, engineers, and product teams to integrate AI\-driven capabilities into customer\-facing products and internal tools.
* Stay up to date with the latest research and trends in LLMs, RAG, and generative AI technologies to drive innovation in the company’s offerings.
* Continuously monitor and optimize models to improve their performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.


**We'd Love For You To Have**
* 2 to 10 years of total experience and strong understanding of LLMs and their underlying principles — transformer architecture, attention mechanisms, and hyperparameter tuning.
* Proven experience designing and building AI agents, including multi\-agent orchestration, tool\-use patterns, multi\-step planning, and agent memory architectures (short\-term and long\-term).
* Hands\-on experience with agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen, and familiarity with RAG pipelines that integrate external knowledge sources (documents, databases, APIs).
* In\-depth knowledge of vector databases and indexing algorithms; practical experience with FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus.
* Experience with agent observability, tracing, and guardrails — tools like Langfuse or equivalent — to ensure reliability, safety, and debuggability of agentic systems.
* Proficiency in prompt engineering — crafting, iterating, and optimizing complex prompts for context\-sensitive, domain\-specific LLM outputs.
* Familiarity with Evals and other performance evaluation tools for measuring model quality, relevance, and efficiency.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.
* Experience with data preprocessing, vectorization, and handling large\-scale datasets.
* Ability to present complex technical ideas and results to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience in building AI agents using graph\-based architectures, including knowledge graph embeddings and graph neural networks (GNNs).
* Experience with training small base models using custom data, including data collection, pre\-processing, and fine\-tuning models to specific domains or tasks.
* Familiarity with deploying AI models on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, or ad auction mechanics.
* Knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar tool\-integration standards
* Publication or contributions to research in AI, LLMs, or related fields.


**Qualification**
 Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute/university.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the globe have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!.
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: Staff Software Engineer - CTV (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help architect and evolve our next\-generation, highly scalable, low\-latency AdServer for Connected TV (CTV) – operating at a scale of 1 trillion\+ requests per day and managing millions of requests per second. This is a technical leadership role for an engineer who wants to shape the architectural direction of the CTV AdServer platform, not just one team’s roadmap, in one of the fastest\-growing areas of programmatic advertising. If you thrive on solving distributed\-systems problems at extreme scale, enjoy influencing engineering direction across multiple teams, and want to be one of the most senior technical voices in the organization, we’d love to talk to you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Product \& Architecture Influence: Influence multiple teams across the AdServer organization by defining and reviewing product and platform architecture and implementations. Identify architectural risks early and propose alternatives and solutions that hold up at trillion\-scale.
* Architectural Oversight: Oversee the design and implementation of critical platform components by maintaining in\-depth knowledge of best practices, technologies, architectures, and emerging technologies, and by setting the technical bar for the AdServer engineering organization.
* Standards \& Decisions: Document and communicate exceptions to architectural standards by capturing significant architectural decisions (ADRs), ensuring decisions and their rationale are visible, durable, and reusable across teams.
* Own end\-to\-end technical direction for the AdServer platform – partnering with Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, Engineering Leads, and Product Leads to translate business needs into a coherent, multi\-quarter technical roadmap.
* Lead the design and evolution of highly reliable, scalable, low\-latency distributed backend platforms and services, and set the technical direction that other teams build on.
* Drive research into emerging technologies, sponsor proof\-of\-concepts, and make build/adopt decisions that materially move the platform forward.
* Act as a technical escalation point across teams – auditing designs for platform stability, reviewing major architecture changes across the AdServer Development Team, and unblocking the hardest cross\-cutting problems.
* Partner with Data Center and DevOps teams on long\-range technical planning – new technology adoption, software optimization strategy, and stability roadmaps for the overall platform.
* Mentor and raise the technical bar of Principal and Senior Principal Engineers, and other senior ICs, through design reviews, architecture forums, and hands\-on technical guidance.
* Champion engineering best practices and documentation standards across teams; ensure designs meet requirements and that platform\-wide work meets a consistently high quality bar.
* Drive the application of GenAI across the software development lifecycle – design, coding, testing, and documentation – and help set the standard for AI\-enabled engineering across the org.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* 14\+ years of hands\-on development experience in C/C\+\+ in a Linux/UNIX environment, with a track record of shipping and evolving large\-scale distributed systems. Experience with Go is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated experience defining architecture and technical direction across multiple teams or a full platform, not just a single service or team.
* Deep proficiency in algorithms and advanced data structures, with a strong foundation in core computer science principles.
* Extensive experience in software design and architecture for complex, scalable, low\-latency, high\-throughput systems.
* A track record of identifying architectural risk ahead of time and driving alternatives that are adopted broadly.
* Ability to write and review architectural decision records, and to communicate trade\-offs clearly to both engineering and product stakeholders.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to find optimal, innovative solutions to open\-ended technical problems.
* Strong working knowledge of generative AI\-based tools and IDEs to accelerate development; comfort with prompt engineering fundamentals and an understanding of different model types at a working level.
* Deep knowledge of OS internals and systems programming – multi\-threading, multi\-processing, and memory management – and the ability to troubleshoot the hardest production issues.
* Ability to write clean, modular, loosely coupled code, and to hold others to that same bar through review.
* Strong end\-to\-end understanding of product functionality across the platform, not just an individual component.
* Working knowledge of scripting (Perl/Python/Shell) and databases (preferably MySQL).
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving alignment across teams without direct authority.


**Good To Have \- CTV Domain Experience**
* Prior hands\-on experience building or scaling ad serving, ad decisioning, or real\-time bidding systems specifically for Connected TV (CTV) / OTT.
* Working knowledge of CTV\-specific technical protocols and standards – e.g. VAST/VPAID/VMAP, SSAI (server\-side ad insertion) and CSAI, HLS/DASH manifest manipulation, and IAB CTV/OTT specifications.
* Understanding of the CTV supply chain and its unique constraints – device\- and app\-level identifiers (e.g. IFA, RIDA), frequency capping and pod/ad\-break management, content\-level targeting, and the latency/quality bar required for a living\-room viewing experience.
* Familiarity with SSAI stitching architectures and the trade\-offs between client\-side and server\-side ad insertion at scale.
* Exposure to OTT/streaming platforms, smart TV operating systems (e.g. Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS), or set\-top box environments, and the constraints they place on ad delivery.
* Understanding of CTV measurement, viewability, and completion\-rate reporting requirements, and how they differ from traditional display/video.
* Awareness of the evolving CTV privacy and identity landscape (e.g. data clean rooms, alternative identifiers, cross\-device graphs) and its implications for ad server architecture.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
 We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS/IT) or an equivalent degree from a well\-known institute or university; advanced degree is a plus but not required given depth of experience.


**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

title: GenAI Developer
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic
 **Generative AI Developer** 
 to join our Controls Technology team and support the development and integration of generative AI solutions. In this hands\-on role, you will work under the guidance of senior developers and AI architects to help build retrieval\-grounded, context\-aware, and increasingly
 **agentic** 
 AI applications. You will contribute to reliable, AI\-driven features while growing your expertise across the modern GenAI stack. This role focuses on
 **applying pre\-trained and hosted foundation models** 
 — through context engineering, RAG, knowledge graphs, and agentic workflows — rather than training or fine\-tuning models.
   

  

 This is a growth\-oriented role: you'll take ownership of well\-scoped components, learn established patterns from senior engineers, and progressively increase your technical depth and independence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Assist in building and integrating generative AI applications using pre\-trained and hosted foundation models (via managed GenAI APIs and open\-model endpoints).
* Support the implementation of context engineering workflows — assembling system instructions, retrieved knowledge, tool definitions, and conversation memory into reliable, token\-efficient prompts, following established patterns.
* Contribute to prompt engineering (zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, role\-based prompting) for AI\-powered workflows.
* Help develop and maintain Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) components, including chunking, embedding, and semantic/keyword search.
* Support the development of knowledge graph and Graph RAG pipelines under guidance to enable grounded, traceable responses.
* Contribute to agentic workflows — helping build AI agents with tool\-calling and basic planning/memory, using frameworks such as Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, or CrewAI.
* Assist with integrating agents to external tools and data sources via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with exposure to the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
* Support the deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of GenAI and agentic applications in production environments.
* Perform data preprocessing, document ingestion, and basic API development for AI applications.
* Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to integrate AI capabilities into products.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to ensure quality and reliability.
* Stay curious about advancements in GenAI and agentic AI, and share learnings with the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Proficiency in Python for GenAI development, data preprocessing, and scripting.
* Solid understanding of core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, tokenization, embeddings, and context windows.
* Hands\-on experience with prompt engineering; foundational understanding of context engineering techniques.
* Practical experience (project or professional) building RAG systems, including chunking, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Familiarity with knowledge graphs and interest in Graph RAG for relationship\-aware retrieval.
* Exposure to agentic AI development — building tool\-using agents or multi\-step workflows with a framework such as Google ADK, LangGraph, CrewAI, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
* Awareness of agent tooling and protocols, including tool/function calling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP); familiarity with the A2A protocol is a plus.
* Basic understanding of agent harness concepts — session/state management, memory, and guardrails.
* Experience consuming major GenAI APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) and exposure to orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Understanding of application deployment and containerization (Docker).
* Working knowledge of version control systems (Git).
* Awareness of AI compliance, data privacy, guardrails, and responsible AI principles.


**Required Soft Skills**
* Strong teamwork and communication abilities.
* Eagerness to learn new AI/GenAI and agentic technologies and frameworks.
* Analytical mindset and attention to detail.
* Openness to feedback, coaching, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
* 4\+ years of experience with min 2–4 years of professional experience in software/AI development, with exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Experience contributing to AI/GenAI or software projects in a collaborative team setting.
* Exposure to cloud\-based AI/ML environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is a plus.

description:

**About the Organisation \& Role:**
 You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing \& fulfilment and post\-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer, you will build the backend services that power omnichannel commerce capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, implementation and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low\-latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* 
* Develop and support scalable services for real\-time inventory availability, allocation, and order promising across digital and physical commerce channels.
* 
* Develop accurate Available\-to\-Sell calculations by combining on\-hand, in\-transit, reserved, allocated, and safety\-stock inventory positions.
* 
* Build order\-promising capabilities that calculate reliable delivery and pickup estimates based on inventory location, fulfilment\-node capacity, carrier options, shipping methods, and operational cut\-off times.
* 
* Implement inventory segmentation and buffer strategies, including safety stock and channel\-specific allocations, to balance availability while minimizing overselling and underselling risks.
* 
* Develop production\-grade microservices using Java and Spring Boot, with a strong focus on scalability, resilience, maintainability, and operational performance.
* 
* Build event\-driven inventory processing using Kafka or similar messaging technologies to handle receipts, adjustments, reservations, releases, cancellations, and fulfilment updates in near real time.
* 
* Integrate inventory and promising services with OMS, commerce, WMS, ERP, store, and fulfilment platforms to provide consistent availability across the order lifecycle.
* 
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient through strong engineering practices.
* 
* Own well\-defined features or components from design through production.
* 
* Write clean, tested and maintainable code, participate in peer reviews, and maintain relevant technical documentation.
* 
* Optimize performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.
* 
* Support production services through monitoring, troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis, contributing to reliability improvements.


**YOUR TALENT:**
* 4\+ years of experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise\-grade applications, preferably within commerce, order management, inventory or supply\-chain domains.
* 
* Hands\-on software engineering experience with Java, Spring Boot and microservices architectures.
* 
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event\-driven architectures, messaging technologies and integration patterns.
* 
* Experience building reliable, scalable, maintainable and production\-grade backend services.
* 
* Practical understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms.
* 
* Experience with automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and production support.
* 
* Understanding of observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* 
* Working knowledge of order lifecycle or inventory\-management concepts such as availability, reservations, ATP, ATS, allocation or fulfilment.

* Experience integrating with OMS, WMS, ERP, commerce or fulfilment platforms will be an advantage.

* Experience configuring and extending Distributed Order Management Systems (OMS), with Fluent Commerce experience preferred.
* 
* Experience with Kafka or equivalent messaging technologies.

title: Software Engineer, Business Systems
description:
**Function:** 
 Business Technology \& Security — Business Systems
   

  

**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  

* Hybrid


**Reports to:** 
 Product Manager, Business Systems
   

  

**Experience:** 
 2–4 years
   

  

**Short Description**
 Build and run the integrations, pipelines, automations and internal tools that connect Mindtickle's business systems — Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack and Google Cloud. You take defined requirements and own the technical path end to end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Business Technology \& Security runs the systems, automation and security behind how Mindtickle operates.
 **Business Systems** 
 is its build engine — the team that turns requirements from GTM, Finance, People Success, IT, Legal and Security into shipped systems: integrations, data pipelines, automations, internal tools and agents.
   

  

 We are a small team. You will not be part of a traditional engineering squad with sprints and Scrum ceremonies. You will operate independently, usually owning a problem from a defined requirement through to a deployed, monitored solution — and then continuing to own it.
   

  

**The role**
 You are the engineer on the team. When a system needs to talk to another system, when a manual process needs to become an automated one, when a tool needs to exist and doesn't — you build it.
   

  

 Requirements come to you defined. The Product Manager and Business Systems Analyst own the business problem, the stakeholders, and the question of whether we should do it at all.
 **The technical path is entirely yours** 
 — how it's designed, what it's built on, how it's tested, how it fails safely, and how it's supported once it's live.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
**Building — about half your time** 
 Integrations between business systems. Data pipelines. Automations that remove manual work from Finance, People Success, IT, Security and GTM. Internal tools and lightweight services. AI\-backed workflows and agents where they are the right answer, and conventional code where they are not.
   

  

**Running it — about a fifth of your time** 
 You inherit a set of automations already in production and become their owner. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the unglamorous work of making inherited systems observable and documented. Nothing you build gets handed to someone else to support.
   

  

**Technical evaluation — about 15%** 
 When the team is deciding whether to build or buy, or whether a vendor's API can actually do what the demo claimed, you build the prototype that answers it. Deep technical spikes, integration feasibility, and performance and security reality\-checks — against a requirement the Product Manager and Analyst have already defined.
   

  

**Migrations — about 15%** 
 Data migration, field mapping, cutover scripts and system replacements as we move platforms.
   

  

**The shape of a typical week**
**Daily** 
 — Writing Python with Claude Code. Reading vendor API documentation. Wiring REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and event\-driven flows. Debugging a sync that silently dropped records. Deploying to Cloud Run.
   

  

**Weekly** 
 — Shipping an increment and demoing it. Working through requirements with the Product Manager and Analyst. Triaging what broke.
   

  

**Monthly** 
 — One meaningful capability live in production, with monitoring, a runbook, and documentation good enough that someone else could pick it up.
   

  

**Stack**
 Python
   

  

* Google Apps Script
* Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine)
* REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth and service\-account authentication
* Claude Code and modern AI tooling as a primary way of working
* Git and CI/CD


 Business systems you will integrate with: Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack, Google Workspace, and the wider SaaS estate.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We care about what you have built and kept alive, not the tools listed on your CV.
   

  

* 2–4 years building software, integrations or automations in a professional environment
* Strong Python, and real fluency with APIs — authentication, rate limits, retries, idempotency, pagination, webhooks and event\-driven patterns
* You have built integrations against SaaS APIs, not only configured them through consoles or drag\-and\-drop integration platforms
* Hands\-on cloud experience (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine) with a working understanding of how to compose services rather than follow a tutorial
* End\-to\-end ownership you can point to — a system you designed, built, shipped and then operated. Something that broke in production and you fixed it.
* Debugging across system boundaries — when two systems disagree about the same record, you can work out why
* Testing and verification instinct — you know your output is correct because you measured it, not because it ran without erroring
* Fast on unfamiliar ground — you have picked up a stack you didn't know and shipped it. This matters more to us than prior exposure to any specific technology.
* Clear written communication — design notes, runbooks, and documentation are part of the job, not an afterthought


**Nice to have**
* Building AI agents, tool\-use, and agentic workflows; MCP servers
* Exposure to business systems — CRM, ERP, HRIS, ITSM — and the SaaS ecosystem around them
* Data and pipeline work (BigQuery, ETL/ELT)

title: Senior Python Application Developer - Vice President
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a highly experienced, technically proficient, and execution\-focused
 **Senior Python Application Developer** 
 with
 **12\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 to design, architect, and deliver critical, horizontally scalable, highly available, and performant applications. This role demands deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and modern DevOps practices, combined with a strong background in quantitative computation and market risk domains.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technical leader who can drive software engineering excellence, manage technical aspects of complex projects (including planning, governance, and budgeting), and collaborate effectively with globally matrixed teams, including Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, and Front Office (FO) teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architecture, Design \& Hands\-on Development
* Lead Implementation: Lead the hands\-on implementation and architecture of robust Python frameworks to build horizontally scalable, highly available, highly resilient, and performant applications.
* Platform Engineering: Design and develop efficient software platforms for high\-throughput data computation, processing, and quantitative calculations.
* Standards \& Alignment: Develop solutions adhering to enterprise architectural standards, utilizing in\-depth technical and business domain knowledge.
* Database \& API Design: Design, develop, and secure high\-performance RESTful APIs, integration patterns, and database schemas (relational and NoSQL).
* Technical Leadership, Governance \& Delivery
* SDLC \& Code Quality: Enforce industry\-standard SDLC best practices and contribute to code quality through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration.
* Project Ownership: Take full ownership of technical initiatives, including planning, forecasting, project tracking, governance, and managing technology budgets at the team level.
* Change Management: Drive continuous improvement, change management, and modern software engineering practices within the development team.
* Independent Execution: Work independently, multi\-task, and manage priorities effectively under pressure to meet tight deadlines or unexpected changes in requirements.
* Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management
* Cross\-Functional Partnership: Act as a key liaison and partner with Risk Managers, Risk Analytics, Senior Quants, Front Office (FO), DevOps, and Production Support teams to ensure seamless IT deliveries.
* Global Collaboration: Work effectively in a globally matrixed environment, partnering with virtual teams and external partners across different time zones.
* Executive Communication: Consistently demonstrate clear, concise, and impactful written and verbal communication, ranging from technical discussions within the team to presentations for senior business executives.


**Required Technical Qualifications**
 I. Core Python, DSA \& System Development
   

  

* Experience: 12\+ years of hands\-on application development experience, with a primary focus on Python, Data Structures and Algorithms.
* Python Expertise: Expert\-level Python 3\.x proficiency, with deep knowledge of core concepts, advanced computation libraries, and design patterns (OOP, SOLID).
* Frameworks: Advanced knowledge of Python web and API frameworks (FastAPI, Django, Flask).
* Distributed Systems: Strong understanding of software architecture principles and distributed system design (Microservices, Event\-Driven Architecture, caching strategies).
* Database Systems: Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis), including advanced SQL query writing and optimization.
* Operating Systems: Highly experienced with Unix/Linux\-based operating systems, shell scripting, and system\-level development.


 II. Cloud, DevOps \& Testing
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: Strong background in cloud platforms AWS or IBM symphony grid.
* Containerization \& Orchestration: Hands\-on experience with Docker containerization and contributing to Kubernetes orchestration.
* CI/CD Pipelines: Proven exposure to and experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) systems (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines) for automated deployment.
* Testing \& TDD: Proficiency in automated testing frameworks (Pytest, unittest) and Test\-Driven Development (TDD) methodologies.
* Security: Solid understanding of secure coding practices and application of security principles (OWASP Top 10\).
* Version Control: Expertise in Git (Bitbucket, GitHub) for advanced branching, merging, and pull request workflows.


 III. Quantitative \& Risk Domain
   

  

* Quantitative Computation: Multiple years of experience developing quantitative/calc\-intensive Python solutions with advanced computation libraries (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, SciPy).
* Risk Methodologies: Sound understanding of and exposure to various Risk Methodologies (e.g., Market Risk, Stress Testing, Value at Risk (VaR), Sensitivities).
* Domain Delivery: Proven track record of delivering Stress Testing and Regulatory Risk projects in the Market Risk domain.
* Mathematical Modeling: Exposure to mathematical modeling and financial insights.


 IV. Artificial Intelligence (AI) Integration (Exposure)
   

  

* AI/ML Frameworks: Exposure to AI/ML tools and frameworks.
* Development Workflows: Practical experience utilizing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Devin, Claude, Gemini, GPT) to optimize development workflows.
* Agentic AI: Experience with Agentic AI tools, including writing Agents and Skills, and contributing to Agentic frameworks.
* Generative AI: Understanding and practical application of Generative AI concepts in software development.


 Professional \& Leadership Skills
   

  

* Agile/Scrum: Deep understanding and practical experience working within Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical, logical, systems thinking, and critical analysis skills.
* Design Thinking: Demonstrated design thinking skills to solve complex business and technical problems.
* Ownership \& Adaptability: Ability to take complete ownership of various parts of a project, adapt to changing priorities, and perform under pressure.


 Preferred / "Good to Have" Qualifications
   

  

* Banking Domain: Prior experience working within the banking/financial services domain, specifically in pricing, valuation, or risk management systems.
* Certifications: Relevant Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) or Industry Certifications.
* Financial Certifications: CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst) or FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certification is a strong plus.

title: Senior Embedded Software Developer — Python & Embedded Linux
description:
**About the Company**




  





 i\-TEK RFID is one of India’s leading RFID and intelligent automation companies with over 25 years of experience in delivering enterprise\-grade solutions across retail, logistics, supply chain, FASTag, E\-Seal, warehousing and industrial automation.
 



 Our solutions power some of the largest retail and enterprise transformation initiatives in India.
 



 As part of our expansion strategy, we are looking to strengthen our South India sales team.
 



  





**About the Role**




  





 We are looking for a Senior Embedded Software Developer with strong hands\-on experience in Python and Embedded Linux to develop software for our ARM64/x86\_64\-based embedded products.
 



 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role, focused on building production\-grade applications that interact with hardware, provide local graphical interfaces, and communicate with backend/cloud systems.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Develop and maintain production\-grade Python applications on Embedded Linux.
* Build responsive PyQt/PySide GUI applications for industrial/touchscreen devices.
* Integrate and control hardware using GPIO, UART/RS232/RS485, SPI, I2C, USB, and Ethernet.
* Integrate RFID readers and industrial peripherals with embedded applications.
* Develop MQTT\-based device communication for telemetry, commands, events, and remote configuration.
* Integrate embedded applications with REST APIs and web/backend services.
* Develop background services, device monitoring, diagnostics, logging, and recovery mechanisms.
* Build Python\-based automated tests and production tools for device configuration and validation.
* Work with Linux services, systemd, networking, processes, threads, and device interfaces.
* Debug and resolve hardware/software integration issues in development and production.
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code and participate in code reviews.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  




* 3\-5 years of software/embedded development experience.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Strong Python 3 development experience.
* Strong experience with PyQt, PySide, or Qt.
* Hands\-on Embedded Linux experience.
* Experience with GPIO and hardware interfaces.
* Experience with UART/serial communication and industrial peripherals.
* Experience with RFID integration is highly desirable.
* Strong experience with MQTT and REST APIs.
* Good understanding of HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, TCP/IP, and networking.
* Experience with Python threading, asyncio, multiprocessing, or event\-driven programming.
* Experience with systemd/Linux services and embedded device deployment.
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills.
* Good Git and software development practices.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* ARM64 SBCs such as Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, or custom boards.
* Yocto or Buildroot.
* Docker on Embedded Linux.
* OTA updates and remote device management.
* WebSockets and cloud IoT platforms.
* Hardware\-in\-the\-loop and production test automation.
* Working knowledge of C/C\+\+ for understanding and debugging low\-level components.



  





 Python is the primary development language. Embedded Linux, PyQt, GPIO, MQTT, REST, and hardware integration are the core focus of this role.
 



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





  





 We are committed to diversity and inclusivity.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Sitecore
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Responsible for leading the architecture, development, and delivery of Sitecore\-based digital experience platform. Provides technical leadership in designing scalable solutions, establishing development standards, and ensuring the performance, security, and reliability
   

  

 of Sitecore platforms. Leads and mentors Sitecore development teams, drives technical excellence, and collaborates with business, product, and content stakeholders to deliver innovative digital solutions aligned with organizational objectives, industry best practices, and established technology standards.
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the Sitecore solution architecture, development standards, technical governance, and best practices to ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable digital experience solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and support Sitecore developers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and promoting engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
* Design, develop, and oversee integrations between Sitecore and internal enterprise systems, APIs, cloud services, and third\-party platforms to support business and digital transformation requirements.
* Drive technical solution design, effort estimation, sprint planning, and technical decision\-making to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with business objectives.
* Ensure the scalability, performance, security, availability, and reliability of the Sitecore platform by implementing industry best practices and proactively addressing technical risks.
* Collaborate with marketing, content, product, UX/UI, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into effective digital experience solutions.
* Evaluate emerging Sitecore capabilities, .NET technologies, and digital experience trends, recommending improvements that enhance platform capability, application quality, and development efficiency.
* Support application deployment, release planning, and production issue resolution while ensuring compliance with established development, security, and release management processes.


**People Management**
* Provides direction, coaching and guidance to team members for their career and professional development.
* Creates a conducive working environment to build and sustain a performance driven, engaged, and committed team.
* Ensures people management responsibilities are handled effectively in line with company procedures.


**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
 Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. With 8\-10 years of experience including strong Sitecore expertise (9 / 10, SXA, XM / XP). Travel, airline, or e\-commerce platform experience is preferred. Sitecore certifications are preferred.
   

  

 Work Experience
   

  

* Fluent in English Language
* Strong understanding of Sitecore architecture, implementation standards, and development best practices.
* Experience with CMS architecture, content modelling, and digital experience platforms.
* Strong proficiency in .NET, C\#, and ASP.NET development.
* Experience with Headless Sitecore solutions, including Sitecore JSS and Next.js.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and platform implementations.
* Knowledge of personalization capabilities and digital experience optimization.
* Experience in travel, airline, or e\-commerce domains is preferred.
* Proven experience in technical leadership, team mentoring, and CI/CD implementation.

title: Principal Software Engineer - 260421-6
description:
**About Kaseya**
 Kaseya is the leading provider of AI\-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long\-term business success.
   

  

 Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double\-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.
   

  

 Founded in 2000, Kaseya has built a culture centered around innovation, accountability, and results. We are a high\-growth, high\-performance organization that values individuals who are driven, adaptable, and committed to delivering exceptional outcomes for our customers and teammates alike.
   

  

 At Kaseya, success comes from embracing challenges, moving with urgency, and continuously raising the bar.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The
 **Principal Software Engineer** 
 will lead the technical strategy, architecture, and evolution of critical, large\-scale systems that support key business capabilities. This role will drive company\-wide architectural initiatives, AI adoption, platform modernization, and engineering excellence while influencing senior leadership and aligning multiple engineering organizations toward long\-term technical and business goals.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design and evolution of large\-scale, distributed systems and platform architectures.
* Define and drive company\-wide technical strategy aligned with long\-term business and product objectives.
* Establish architectural principles, standards, and best practices to ensure scalability, consistency, and maintainability.
* Drive the strategic adoption of AI\-assisted development practices and AI\-enabled capabilities across the organization.
* Lead cross\-functional and cross\-organizational initiatives spanning multiple systems, domains, and business units.
* Identify and mitigate systemic technical risks and drive long\-term modernization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
* Advance system reliability, scalability, performance, observability, and operational maturity across the organization.
* Mentor and influence senior technical talent while promoting a culture of engineering excellence and high technical standards.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience defining and driving technical strategy at an organizational or company\-wide level.
* Deep experience designing and evolving large\-scale distributed systems and cloud\-based platform architectures.
* Strong hands\-on experience with public cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and cloud\-native architecture patterns.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive technical alignment across multiple teams and organizations without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Autonomous Flight & Robotics Software Engineer (Drone Tech)
description:
Senior Autonomous Systems / Flight Software Engineer (On\-Site)
   

  

**Location:** 
 R\&D Center \& Robotics Lab (Full\-Time, 100% In\-Office)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4–8 Years
   

  

**Department:** 
 Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) Flight Control \& Autonomy
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an expert
 **Autonomous Flight Software Engineer** 
 to build the onboard intelligence and navigation algorithms that power our next\-generation enterprise drone fleets. In this hands\-on, on\-site role, you will work directly inside our hardware robotics lab and engineering headquarters. You will bridge low\-level sensor integration with high\-level path planning, enabling uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) to execute complex, GPS\-denied, and fully autonomous missions for industrial inspection and logistics.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Detailed Breakdown:** 
**1\. Flight Control \& Guidance Algorithm Development**
* Design, implement, and test advanced guidance, navigation, and control (GNC) algorithms for fixed\-wing and multi\-rotor UAV platforms.
* Integrate and tune open\-source flight controller stacks (such as PX4 or ArduPilot) with custom hardware payloads and companion computers (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson).
* Develop real\-time state estimation frameworks using sensor fusion techniques (Extended Kalman Filters combining IMU, GPS, LiDAR, and optical flow cameras).
* Autonomous Navigation \& Computer Vision Integration
* Build collision\-avoidance, obstacle\-detection, and real\-time path\-replanning algorithms using computer vision and point\-cloud data (OpenCV, PCL, ROS/ROS2\).
* Program autonomous mapping, waypoint navigation, and target\-tracking workflows designed for BVLOS (Beyond Visual Line of Sight) operations.
* Optimize edge\-AI inference pipelines running on drone companion boards to process imagery or telemetry locally in real\-time.
* Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) \& Lab Testing
* Conduct rigorous Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) and Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SIL) simulation tests using tools like Gazebo or AirSim to validate flight safety before physical test flights.
* Partner face\-to\-face with electrical and mechanical hardware engineers in our robotics lab to debug sensor faults, actuator lags, and power\-distribution anomalies.
* Participate in ground\-station setup, telemetry logging analysis, and field\-test post\-mortems immediately following outdoor flight trials.
* Safety Compliance \& System Reliability
* Ensure all flight software meets rigorous safety\-critical fault\-tolerance standards, including fail\-safe return\-to\-home protocols and geofencing limits.
* Maintain clean version control, unit test coverage, and documentation for all onboard code modules in adherence to aviation and industrial compliance standards.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 
  

  

* Work Mode: 100% On\-site commitment with daily physical presence in our engineering lab, test bench facilities, and development hub.
* Core Technical Stack:
+ Advanced proficiency in C\+\+ and Python (Linux/Ubuntu environment).
+ Deep experience with ROS / ROS2 (Robot Operating System).
+ Hands\-on familiarity with flight control firmware (PX4 / ArduPilot) and MAVLink communication protocols.
+ Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, AirSim) and sensor fusion frameworks.

* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of drone aerodynamics, coordinate frames (NED/ENU), PID controllers, and payload integration (thermal cameras, LiDAR, multi\-spectral sensors).
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics, or equivalent practical systems engineering experience.


**Why Join Us On\-Site?**
 Developing software for flying hardware requires tight coordination. Being physically present in our robotics lab allows you to push code, mount the companion computer directly onto the drone airframe, and test modifications on the physical test bench within minutes.
   

  

 Skills: gazebos,airsim,python,px4,ned,c\+\+,pid controllers,ros,ardupilot,lidar technology
